> 第八章 冬灵素（第1页）
一旦出现了这种的情况来说，就已经证明一点，冯斗离初级丹药师已经走出了第一步，正是因为这样，冯斗才能够做到离初级丹药师更进一步的。
此时冯斗看到了希望之后，他继续将另外一样药材——雪谷草丢进了药鼎之中，有了第一次经验之后，他此时显然操作起来都是非常之容易了。
冯斗此时用了非常之短的时间就将小药丸炼出来，与此同时冯斗更加是小心翼翼地控制住两个小药丸，生怕它们刷落一地，这样就要前功尽弃啦!
同时冯斗直接将第三种药材丢进去，他很快就将第三种炼成小药丸，三种小药丸在空中不断地旋转起来，慢慢地融合，又慢慢地分开。
仿佛经历不断的改变之后，冯斗额头上的汗水不断地留下来，由于第一次炼丹，然而需要精神力超强集中，对于冯斗这种还没有正式修炼精神力的，绝对是一种煎熬，一旦有丝毫的松懈，那就会前功尽弃的。
对于冯斗这种追求完美的人绝对不会允许这样的事情发生，就算耗尽精神力，他也不惜借此来锻炼自己的微薄精神力。
冯斗真的越来越觉得需要提升自己的精神力，因为他看到燕京的笔记之中，得知道的信息就是越到后面的修炼就越需要大量的精神力。
然而冯斗有打算做一名炼药师的，那么他的精神力绝对不能够低，一旦出现这样的情况，他在炼药师之路绝对不能够久远的。
冯斗此时的精神力还算不上什么等级，他现在只能够感觉到丝丝的精神力而已，他此时炼制的药丹在一定程度上还是算不上什么初级丹药。
药鼎此时三股药水不断地融合，不断地碰撞。
冯斗看到一刻时，他内心不由得有那么一丝丝欣慰的。
一旦这一颗药丹成功之后，就可以证明了他正式走上炼药师的道路。
他也不知道过了多久，丹药就慢慢地形成，最后飞出药鼎，冯斗飞身接过那颗丹药，用一个瓶子接着了。
冯斗此时接着炼药，但是接下来的几次都是失败告终的，但是他也是很高兴的，毕竟现在能够成功炼制一颗冬灵素，他已经非常之满意了。
冯斗并没有打算将这一颗冬灵素留下来，与此同时，他准备尝试一下这一颗自己所炼制的冬灵素药力到底到达什么地步啦！
他将那颗冬灵素丢进了嘴里，他一下子感觉到一股冰凉的感觉由喉咙直接滑下来，冯斗连忙运转自己体内的灵气，用灵气去驱使冬灵素的寒气。
那一股寒气不断地在体内运转，跟着他体内的经脉不断地走动。
也不知道过了多久之后，他终于将体内的那股寒气完全地消耗掉，他一下子就已经突破了灵动第三段，直接达到了灵动第四段中期，这一点远远地超出了冯斗所料。
他现在也开始慢慢地明白一点，那就是为什么一名炼药师可以等于上千名同等级的灵修者的直接原因。
冯斗并没有马上离开，因为此时的他刚刚突破修为，他需要时间来巩固自己的修为，只有这样才可以做步步为营。
也只有这样才能够做巩固自己的修炼基础，为自己以后修炼道路打下巨大的好处。
可是这时就更加让冯斗意想不到的事情发生，那就是他的身体开始有了一点不对劲，他原本打算要收功时，他觉得有一股不是他可以阻止的灵气不断地乱冲击，有点像要冲破他气海一样。
可是此时他比任何人都要清楚的事情，就是一旦气海被冲破，就相当于说他的修行之路完全结束了。

> Chapter 8 Winter Spirit (Page 1)
Once this situation occurs, it has been proven that Feng Dou has taken the first step away from being a junior alchemist. It is precisely because of this that Feng Dou can take a step closer to becoming a junior alchemist.
At this time, Feng Dou saw hope, and he continued to throw another medicinal material, Snow Valley Grass, into the medicine cauldron. After his first experience, it was obviously very easy for him to operate it at this time.
It took Feng Dou a very short time to make the small pills. At the same time, Feng Dou controlled the two small pills even more carefully, for fear that they would fall to the ground and all his efforts would be wasted!
At the same time, Feng Dou directly threw the third medicinal material in, and he quickly made the third medicine into small pills. The three small pills continued to rotate in the air, slowly merging, and then slowly separating.
It seems that after experiencing constant changes, the sweat on Feng Dou's forehead continues to remain. Since it is the first time to make alchemy, it requires super mental concentration. For someone like Feng Dou who has not formally practiced mental power, it is definitely a kind of torture. Once he relaxes in the slightest, all his previous efforts will be wasted.
For a person like Feng Dou who pursues perfection, he will never allow such a thing to happen. Even if he exhausts his mental power, he will not hesitate to use this to exercise his meager mental power.
Feng Douzhen felt more and more that he needed to improve his mental power, because he saw in Yan Jing's notes that the information he learned was that the further you go in practice, the more mental power you need.
However, if Feng Dou intends to become an alchemist, then his mental strength must not be low. Once such a situation occurs, he will never be able to remain an alchemist for a long time.
Feng Dou's mental power at this time is not at a high level. He can only feel the slightest amount of mental power now. The medicine pill he refined at this time is still not a primary medicine pill to a certain extent.
At this time, the three strands of medicine in the medicine cauldron are constantly merging and colliding.
When Feng Dou saw it, he couldn't help but feel a little bit relieved in his heart.
Once this medicine pill is successful, it will prove that he has officially embarked on the path of alchemist.
He didn't know how long it took for the elixir to slowly form, and finally flew out of the cauldron. Feng Doufei took the elixir and put it in a bottle.
Feng Dou continued to refine the medicine at this time, but the next few times ended in failure, but he was also very happy. After all, he was very satisfied that he could successfully refine a winter spirit element.
Feng Dou had no intention of keeping this Donglingsu. At the same time, he was ready to try out the potency of the Donglingsu he had refined!
He threw the winter spirit element into his mouth, and he suddenly felt a cold feeling sliding down his throat. Feng Dou quickly circulated the spiritual energy in his body, using the spiritual energy to drive away the cold energy of the winter spirit element.
The cold air was constantly circulating in his body, following the meridians in his body.
I don't know how long it took, but he finally completely consumed the cold energy in his body. He suddenly broke through the third level of spiritual movement and directly reached the middle of the fourth stage of spiritual movement. This was far beyond Feng Dou's expectation.
Now he is slowly beginning to understand something, which is the direct reason why one alchemist can be equal to thousands of spiritual practitioners of the same level.
Feng Dou did not leave immediately, because he had just broken through in cultivation at this time, and he needed time to consolidate his cultivation. Only in this way could he make progress step by step.
Only in this way can we consolidate our own cultivation foundation and lay huge benefits for our future cultivation path.
But at this time, something even more unexpected happened to Feng Dou, that is, something was wrong with his body. When he was about to stop his power, he felt that there was a spiritual energy that he could not stop that was constantly attacking, a bit like it was trying to break through his sea of ​​energy.
But what he knew better than anyone at this time was that once the Qi Sea was broken through, it was equivalent to saying that his path of cultivation was completely over.
